pages.text: The Tinker's Anvil can also be used to forge armor pieces when a modpack adds those recipes with CraftTweaker. Most modded metals can be supported by pairing JSON materials with scripted anvil recipes.

pages.title: Helmets
pages.text: A pack can add a helmet recipe with CraftTweaker, commonly five ingots into one helmet.

pages.title: Chestplates
pages.text: A pack can add a chestplate recipe with CraftTweaker, commonly eight ingots into one chestplate.

pages.title: Leggings
pages.text: A pack can add a leggings recipe with CraftTweaker, commonly seven ingots into one pair of leggings.

pages.title: Boots
pages.text: A pack can add a boots recipe with CraftTweaker, commonly four ingots into one pair of boots.
